statement: Although SP-14 reports that every photograph is backed up, the controlling case facts say this album is the only copy, so the value for this case is **keep**.
judge_text:
WRONG
It identifies the record's "backed up" field as contradicting the stated fact that this is the only copy ("the controlling case facts say this album is the only copy"), and gives the correct action, keep.
